Why is it locked?''"
"''It's supposed to be.''"
"''It hasn't been locked all year.''"
"''We know. We fixed it.''"
"''What?|Pono and Jeen|}} '''Magla''' was a [[humanoid]] [[Magla's species|alien]] [[cyborg]] who worked as a console [[technician]] in the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Senate]]. In [[2 BBY]], Magla and their colleague [[Jeen]] locked a usually open tech closet in the [[Senate Broadcast Center|Broadcast Center]] of the [[Imperial Senate Building]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] in order to follow protocol. The next [[Local day|day]], the Senate [[Security officer|security official]] [[Pono]] questioned Jeen and Magla about why the door was locked while he tried to shut off a live broadcast from the [[Galactic Senate Chamber]], where [[Senior Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] was giving a speech criticizing the Empire and the [[Ghorman Massacre|massacre]] it had carried out on the planet [[Ghorman]]. Jeen told Pono the sequence key for the door was in the [[Security Office]], and so he stormed away as the two technicians shared a smile. ==Biography== ===Just following protocol=== {{Quote|We checked the protocol—''"
"''Open it!''"
"''You need the sequence key.''"
"''So let's have it!''"
"''We took it up to the Security Office yesterday.|Jeen and Pono|}} Magla was an [[Magla's species|alien]] who worked as a console [[technician]] in the [[Imperial Senate Building]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Senate]] on the Imperial [[capital]] [[planet]],''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' [[Coruscant]]. In [[2 BBY]],{{AndorDate|209}} Magla and fellow console technician [[Jeen]] locked a door within the [[Senate Broadcast Center]] that led to a tech closet where the power level to cut live broadcasts from the Senate was located. The door had been unlocked all [[Standard year|year]], but according to protocol it should be locked, and so Magla and Jeen delivered the sequence key for the door to the Senate's [[Security Office]]. The following [[Local day|day]], an early session of the Senate was called to discuss the [[Ghorman Massacre]], a [[Death|slaughter]] of [[Ghorman (people)|Ghorman]] citizens on the planet Ghorman by the Empire that had also occured the previous [[Standard day|day]]. Although most [[senator]]s initially stuck to pro-Imperial talking points during the start of the session, which was being broadcast live, [[Senior Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] was eventually ceeded the floor in the [[Galactic Senate Chamber]], despite not being on the agenda, due to the support of a wide [[Axis network|network]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebellious]] allies. ===Speeches and smiles=== Mothma gave a speech decrying the massacre and criticizing the Empire and state of the Senate, causing the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] to issue orders to the Broadcast Center [[Security officer|security official]]{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}} {{AD|Disney+}} [[Pono]] to shut off the broadcast. Pono headed to the tech closet, but was surprised when the door failed to open after he input the code. Becoming increasingly stressed, he spoke with Magla and Jeen outside the door, demanding to know why the door was locked. Jeen explained that the two technicians had followed protocol when they locked it, directing him to the Security Office when he demanded the key. As Pono hurridly stormed away, Magla and Jeen exchanged a smile. Pono eventually gained entry to the closet and shut off the broadcast just after Mothma called [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] a monster. ==Personality and traits== Magla was a [[humanoid]] [[cyborg]] with light skin. ==Equipment== Magla had a piece of [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]] equipment on their head that wrapped around the back of their [[Bone|skull]] and extended up over each of their [[eye]]s. It produced an electronic whirring sound. In the Broadcast Center, the technician wore a blue [[jumpsuit]] over a gray shirt with a brown tool [[belt]]. ==Behind the scenes== Magla appeared in the [[Welcome to the Rebellion|ninth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' which aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} They went uncredited in the episode. The character's name was then revealed in the episode's script when it was published on [[Disney Debut]]. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{Disney|subdomain=assets.debut|url=documents/Andor%20209%20--%20POST%20FINAL%20--%203.3.24%5B1%5D.pdf|text=Episode #209 "Welcome To The Rebellion" Script|format=PDF}} {{1stID|Magla}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=მაგლა }} [[Category:Cyborgs]] [[Category:Humanoids]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Technicians]] [[Category:Individuals of unidentified species]]
